ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across ~95% of visible surface with low-intensity (black) pixel concentration restricted to the extreme distal tips and a narrow trailing edge perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; thin continuous low-intensity black banding along the trailing edge boundary; localized dark pixel clusters (dots) on the right distal lobe extremity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetrical V-shaped central depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 100 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-peaks and valleys along the entire length of the trailing edge; distinct serration pattern clearly defined against the lighter water surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the anterior boundary tapering to sharp distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave sweep converging at the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of approximately 3-4 distinct dark circular pixel anomalies located on the high-intensity background of the distal right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark pigmentation spots on the right distal fluke tip; otherwise no major physical trauma or amputations visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive near-total white pigmentation of the ventral surface with minimal central mottling.
